rules.text: Do not flag seasonal vegetation color changes (e.g., green to brown fields) or phenological shifts as building anomalies.
rules.justification: The agent incorrectly identified natural seasonal changes in field coloration and tree line health as defects. These are temporal variations in vegetation, not structural building changes.

rules.text: Ignore global image quality differences such as color casts, desaturation, or texture variations when no specific building structure is missing or added.
rules.justification: The agent flagged global texture and color inconsistencies as anomalies. These are likely due to sensor or atmospheric differences between acquisition dates, not actual building changes.

rules.text: Do not classify natural landscape features like winding roads, ponds, or forest density variations as anomalies if they are consistent with the terrain.
rules.justification: The agent misidentified static natural features (roads, water bodies) as anomalies. These are permanent landscape elements, not transient building changes.
